```{r sample size calculation 5year KFRE}
# Calculate R squared based on: (https://www.bmj.com/content/bmj/368/bmj.m441.full.pdf)
#https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pmsampsize/pmsampsize.pdfhttps://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pmsampsize/pmsampsize.pdf
#Major RW, Shepherd D, Medcalf JF, Xu G, Gray LJ, Brunskill NJ. The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study. PLOS Medicine. 2019;16(11):e1002955.

##5-year
# Royston's D
D <- 5.5*(0.926-0.5)+10.26*(0.926-0.5)^3 # using R. Major's C statistic 0.926 for 5 years
# = 3.136188

# R^2_D
R_d <- (((pi/8)*(D^2))) / ((((pi^2)/6) + (pi/8)*D^2))
# = 0.7013226519

# R^2_OQ
R_OQ <- (((-pi^2/6)*0.7013226519)) / ((1 - (pi^2/6))*0.7013226519 - 1)
# = 0.7943428113
# log rank (LR) then needs R_OQ and number of events from R. Major's cohort (429 within 5 years)
LR <- -429*log(1-R_OQ)
# 678.482645702996

# Find R^2_Cox-Snell using LR and sample size from R. Major (proportion of overall variation explained)
R_CS <- 1-exp(-LR/35539)
# = 0.0189101307313638

# Run sample size
pmsampsize("s", rsquared=R_CS, parameters=4, shrinkage=0.9, rate=0.0121, timepoint=5, meanfup=4.7)
#1884 with 108 outcome events

```

```{r sample size calculation 2year KFRE}
# Calculate R squared based on: (https://www.bmj.com/content/bmj/368/bmj.m441.full.pdf)
#Major RW, Shepherd D, Medcalf JF, Xu G, Gray LJ, Brunskill NJ. The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study. PLOS Medicine. 2019;16(11):e1002955

##2-year
# Royston's D
D <- 5.5*(0.933-0.5)+10.26*(0.933-0.5)^3 # using R. Major's C statistic 0.933 for 2 years
# = 3.214434

# R^2_D
R_d <- ((pi/8)*D^2) / ((pi^2)/6 + (pi/8)*D^2)
# = 0.711543277441581

# R^2_OQ
R_OQ <- ((-pi^2/6)*R_d) / ((1 - (pi^2/6))*R_d - 1)
# = 1.2082430.80227773033843

# LR then needs R_OQ and number of events from R Major's cohort (176 within 2 years)
LR <- -176*log(1-R_OQ)
# 285.276976413242

# Find R^2_Cox-Snell using LR and sample size from R Major
R_CS <- 1-exp(-LR/35539)
# = 0.00799502104753647

# Run sample size
pmsampsize("s", rsquared=R_CS, parameters=4, shrinkage=0.9, rate=0.005, timepoint=2, meanfup=4.7)
#4483 with 106 events

```

```{r Calculate eGFRs}
ukb = ukb %>%
  mutate(creatinine = `30700-0.0`) %>%
  mutate(creat = creatinine * 0.01131222) %>%
  mutate(cystatinC = `30720-0.0`) %>%
  mutate(cys = cystatinC) %>%
  mutate(sexnumber = ifelse(sex=="Female", 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(ethnicnumber = ifelse(is.na(ethnic), 0,
                        ifelse(ethnic=="black or black british",1,0))) %>%
  mutate(egfrmdrd = MDRD4(creat, sexnumber, age, ethnicnumber)) %>%
  mutate(egfrcr09 = CKDEpi.creat(creat, sexnumber, age, ethnicnumber))%>%
  mutate(egfrcys09 = CKDEpi.cys(cys, sexnumber, age))%>%
  mutate(egfrcrcys12 = CKDEpi.creat.cys(creat, cys, sexnumber, age, ethnicnumber))
```

```{r New Race-free eGFR Equations}
## Adapted from equations on {nephro} package, updated for release of paper by Inker et al, NEJM 2021 (https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2102953)

ukb = ukb %>% 
  mutate(cystatin = `30720-0.0`)


NoRace_eGFRcr <- function(creat, age, sexnumber) {
# Creatinine in micromol/l, age in years, sex == 0 is Female | sex == 1 is Male  
  if (!is.null(creat) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(age))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
    n <- length(creat)
    
    if (length(sexnumber) == n & length(age) == n)
    {
      # Identify missing data and store the index
      idx <- c(1:n)[is.na(creat) | is.na(sexnumber) | is.na(age)]
      
      # Replace missing data with fake data to avoid problems with formulas
      creat[is.na(creat)] <- 10
      sexnumber[is.na(sexnumber)] <- 10
      age[is.na(age)] <- 10     
      
      # New eGFR equation for creatinine   
      k <- a <- numeric(n)
      k[sexnumber==0] <- 0.7
      k[sexnumber==1] <- 0.9
      a[sexnumber==0] <- -0.241
      a[sexnumber==1] <- -0.302
      one <- rep(1,n)
      eGFR <- apply(cbind(creat/k,one),1,min,na.rm=T)^a * apply(cbind(creat/k,one),1,max,na.rm=T)^-1.20 * 0.9938^age
      eGFR[sexnumber==0] <- eGFR[sexnumber==0] * 1.012
      
      # Restore missing data at the indexed positions
      eGFR[idx] <- NA
      
      # Output
      142 * eGFR
    } else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } else
    stop ("Some variables are not defined")
}

NoRace_eGFRcrcys <- function(creat, cystatin, age, sexnumber) {
  # Creatinine in micromol/l, age in years, sex == 0 is Female | sex == 1 is Male  
  if (!is.null(creat) & !is.null(cystatin) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(age))
  {
    
    n <- length(creat)
    
    if (length(sexnumber) == n & length(age) == n & length(cystatin) == n)
    {
      # Identify missing data and store the index
      idx <- c(1:n)[is.na(creat) | is.na(cystatin) | is.na(sexnumber) | is.na(age)]
      
      # Replace missing data with fake data to avoid problems with formulas
      creat[is.na(creat)] <- 10
      cystatin[is.na(cystatin)] <- 10
      sexnumber[is.na(sexnumber)] <- 10
      age[is.na(age)] <- 10     
      
      # New eGFR equation for creatinine and cystatin combination  
      k_sex <- rep(1,n)
      k_sex[sexnumber==0] <- 0.963
      k <- rep(0.9,n)
      k[sexnumber==0] <- 0.7
      a <- rep(-0.144,n)
      a[sexnumber==0] <- -0.219
      one <- rep(1,n)
      CR <- cbind(creat/k,one)
      CY <- cbind(cystatin/0.8,one)                 
      eGFR <- 135 * apply(CR,1,min,na.rm=T)^a * apply(CR,1,max,na.rm=T)^-0.544 * apply(CY,1,min,na.rm=T)^-0.323 * apply(CY,1,max,na.rm=T)^(-0.778) * 0.9961^age * k_sex

              
      # Restore missing data at the indexed positions
      eGFR[idx] <- NA
      
      # Output
      eGFR
    } else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } else
    stop ("Some variables are not defined")
}

NoRace_eGFRcys2012 <- function(cystatin, age, sexnumber) {
  # age in years, sex == 0 is Female | sex == 1 is Male  
  if (!is.null(cystatin) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(age))
  {
    
    n <- length(cystatin)
    
    if (length(sexnumber) == n & length(age) == n & length(cystatin) == n)
    {
      # Identify missing data and store the index
      idx <- c(1:n)[is.na(cystatin) | is.na(sexnumber) | is.na(age)]
      
      # Replace missing data with fake data to avoid problems with formulas
      cystatin[is.na(cystatin)] <- 10
      sexnumber[is.na(sexnumber)] <- 10
      age[is.na(age)] <- 10     
      
      # 2012 CKD Epi eGFR equation for cystatin  
      k_sex <- rep(1,n)
      k_sex[sexnumber==0] <- 0.932      
      one <- rep(1,n)
      CY <- cbind(cystatin/0.8,one)                 
      eGFR <- 133 * apply(CY,1,min,na.rm=T)^-.0499 * apply(CY,1,max,na.rm=T)^-1.328 * 0.9961^age * k_sex

              
      # Restore missing data at the indexed positions
      eGFR[idx] <- NA
      
      # Output
      eGFR
    } else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } else
    stop ("Some variables are not defined")
}
```

```{r Identify patients on Renal Replacement Therapy from Hospital Episode data}
#Case definitions from http://biobank.ctsu.ox.ac.uk/crystal/crystal/docs/alg_outcome_esrd.pdf
#RRT codes: E853|N165|N180|N185|Q601|T824|T861|Y602|Y612|Y622|Y841|Z490|Z491|Z492|Z940|Z992|L741|L742|L743|L744|L745|L746|L748|L749|M012|M013|M014|M015|M018|M019|M023|M084|M172|M174|M178|M179|X401|X402|X403|X404|X405|X406|X407|X408|X409|X411|X412|X418|X419|X421|X428|X429|X431

#Identify patients with any MAINTENANCE_RRT diagnostic or operation code
HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT <- ifelse((grepl("N165|T861|Z492|Z940", HES$diag_icd10)),1,0)

HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_sec <- apply(
  subset(HES, select = c(diag_icd10_sec.1:diag_icd10_sec.19)), 
  MARGIN=1, 
  FUN = function(x) {
    ifelse(any(grepl("N165|T861|Z492|Z940", x)), 1,0)})

HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_oper <- ifelse ((grepl("M012|M013|M014|M015|M018|M019|M084|M174|M178|M179|X402|X405|X406|X411|X412", HES$oper4)),1,0)

HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_all <- ifelse ((HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT==1 | HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_sec==1 | HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_oper==1), 1, 0)

#Identify patients with ANY_RRT diagnostic or operation codes
HES$ANY_RRT <- ifelse ((grepl("E853|N165|T824|T861|Y602|Y612|Y622|Y841|Z490|Z491|Z492|Z940|Z992", HES$diag_icd10)),1,0)

HES$ANY_RRT_sec <- apply(
  subset(HES, select = c(diag_icd10_sec.1:diag_icd10_sec.19)), 
  MARGIN=1, 
  FUN = function(x) {
    ifelse(any(grepl("E853|N165|T824|T861|Y602|Y612|Y622|Y841|Z490|Z491|Z492|Z940|Z992", x)), 1,0)})

HES$ANY_RRT_oper <- ifelse((grepl("M012|M013|M014|M015|M018|M019|M084|M174|M178|M179|X401|X402|X403|X404|X405|X406|X407|X408|X409|X411|X412|X418|X419|X421|X428|X429|X431", HES$oper4)),1,0)

HES$ANY_RRT_all <- ifelse ((HES$ANY_RRT==1 | HES$ANY_RRT_sec==1 | HES$ANY_RRT_oper==1), 1, 0)

#Identify patients wtih ANY_CKD5 diagnostic or operation codes
HES$ANY_CKD5 <- ifelse ((grepl("E853|N165|N180|N185|Q601|T861|Z940", HES$diag_icd10)),1,0)

HES$ANY_CKD5_sec <- apply(
  subset(HES, select = c(diag_icd10_sec.1:diag_icd10_sec.19)), 
  MARGIN=1, 
  FUN = function(x) {
    ifelse(any(grepl("E853|N165|N180|N185|Q601|T861|Z940", x)), 1,0)})

HES$ANY_CKD5_oper <- ifelse ((grepl("L741|L742|L743|L744|L745|L746|L748|L749|M012|M013ZM014|M015|M018|M019|M023|M084|M172|M174|M178|M179|X402|X405|X406|X411|X412", HES$oper4)),1,0)

HES$ANY_CKD5_all <- ifelse ((HES$ANY_CKD5==1 | HES$ANY_CKD5_sec==1 | HES$ANY_CKD5_oper==1), 1, 0)

#Identify patients with ANY_RRT AND ANY_CKD5
HES$ERF_COMPOSITE = ifelse(HES$ANY_RRT_all==1 & HES$ANY_CKD5_all==1, 1, 0)

#Identify patients with either ERF_COMPOSITE or MAINTENANCE_RRT
HES$RRT = ifelse(HES$MAINTENANCE_RRT_all==1,1,
                 ifelse(HES$ERF_COMPOSITE==1,1,0))

#Select necessary data
HES = HES %>% 
  select(eid, RRT, epistart, epiend, diag_icd10, diag_icd10_sec.1:diag_icd10_sec.19, admidate, disdate, oper4, opdate) %>%
  filter(RRT==1)

#Remove duplicate patients
HES = HES[!duplicated(HES$eid),]

HES$admidate=as.Date(HES$admidate)
HES$opdate=as.Date(HES$opdate)
```

```{r calculate KFRE using 5 year Major et al. UK recalibrated equations}
# Major RW, Shepherd D, Medcalf JF, Xu G, Gray LJ, Brunskill NJ. The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study. PLOS Medicine. 2019;16(11):e1002955
 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old - egfrcr09  


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, egfrcr09) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09 is old CKDepi equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 

 
  # KFRE equation using new eGFRcrcys No Race 2012 equation 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcrcys12 is 2012 race free eGFRcrcys equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
  # KFRE equation using eGFRcys 2012 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcys_2012<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcys_2012) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcys09 is 2009 CKD-EPI eGFR cystatin C equation (includes race)
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcys_2012))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcys_2012/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
           
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old where all race coded as non-black - egfrcr09_race_allnonblack 


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack is old CKDepi equation with all race coded as nonblack
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 

 
  ukb_CKD = ukb_CKD %>%
      mutate(KFRE_egfrcr091 = KFRE_egfrcr09(age, sexnumber, acr2, egfrcr09))%>%
        mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1 = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121 = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack(age, sexnumber, acr2, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))
      
```

```{r calculate KFRE using 2 year Major et al. UK recalibrated equations}

# Major RW, Shepherd D, Medcalf JF, Xu G, Gray LJ, Brunskill NJ. The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study. PLOS Medicine. 2019;16(11):e1002955
 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old - egfrcr09  


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09_2yr<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, egfrcr09) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09 is old CKDepi equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_1_2yr <- (1-0.9878^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_1_2yr

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 

 
  # KFRE equation using new eGFRcrcys No Race 2012 equation 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_2yr<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcrcys12 is 2012 race free eGFRcrcys equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1_2yr <- (1-0.9878^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(sexnumber-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1_2yr

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
  # KFRE equation using eGFRcys 2012 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_2yr<-function(age, sexnumber, acr2, eGFRcys_2012) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcys09 is 2009 CKD-EPI eGFR cystatin C equation (includes race)
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(sexnumber) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcys_2012))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
```

```{r RRT after initial assessment date }
  select("eid", "asscentdate.x", "admidate.y", "opdate") %>%
  mutate(RRTafter = ifelse(admidate.y >= asscentdate.x | opdate >= asscentdate.x, 1, 0),
```

```{r Multimorbidity}
#MM count based on Ho et al, Barnett et al and Tonelli (42 LTCs, based on Tonelli coding)

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
    mutate(mmcount_nockd=
           (diabetes+
              hypertens+
              painful+
           depression+
           asthma+
           chd+
             dyspepsia+
             constipation+
             alcoholprob+
             psychoactive+
           thyroid+
           rheumatoid+
           copd+
           anxiety+
           ibs+
           stroketia+
           divdis+
           artfib+
           periphvasc+
           heartfail+
           prostdis+
           glauc+
           epilepsy+
           dementia+
           schiz+
           psorex+
           ibd+
           migrane+
           chronicsin+
           anorexbul+
           bronch+
           parkin+
           ms+
           viralhep+
           chronicliv+
           osteo+
           cfs+
           endomet+
           meniere+
           peranae+
           polycyst+
             canceryes))

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(mmcount_nockd_cat = mmcount_nockd %>% 
           cut(breaks=c(0,0.9,1.9,2.9,13), include.lowest=T))

##Calculate Cardiometabolic condition count
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  mutate(card_met_mmcount = 
           (hypertens + chd + periphvasc + artfib + diabetes + heartfail + stroketia))
         
#Create Cardiometabolic LTC categories
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  mutate(card_met_mmcount_cat = cut(card_met_mmcount, c(-1, 0.9, 1.9, 2.9, 6))) %>%
  mutate(card_met_mmcount_cat = as.factor(card_met_mmcount_cat))
         
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(card_met_mmcount_cat = card_met_mmcount_cat %>% 
           fct_recode("0" = "(-1,0.9]",
                      "1" = "(0.9,1.9]",
                      "2" = "(1.9,2.9]",
                      "3 or more" = "(2.9,6]"))

#Multimorbidity clusters - based on Bisquera 2021 Lancet Regional Health -Europe, Sullivan 2021 CKJ, Sullivan 2022 BMC Medicine and previous UK biobank coding of LTCs

##complex pattern of LTCs - LTC from 3 or more body systems
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(neoplasmLTC = ifelse(canceryes==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(haemLTC = ifelse(peranae==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(endoLTC = ifelse(diabetes==1|thyroid==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(mentalLTC = 
    ifelse(depression==1|alcoholprob==1|psychoactive==1|anxiety==1|dementia==1|schiz==1|anorexbul==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(neuroLTC = ifelse(epilepsy==1|parkin==1|ms==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(ophthLTC = ifelse(glauc==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(otoLTC = ifelse(meniere==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(circuLTC = ifelse(hypertens==1|chd==1|stroketia==1|artfib==1|periphvasc==1|heartfail==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(respLTC = ifelse(asthma==1|copd==1|bronch==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(giLTC = ifelse(dyspepsia==1|ibd==1|chronicliv==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(mskLTC = ifelse(rheumatoid==1|osteo==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(guLTC = ifelse(endomet==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(otherLTC = ifelse(painful==1|cfs==1, 1, 0))

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(complexLTC_count = neoplasmLTC + haemLTC + endoLTC + mentalLTC  + neuroLTC + ophthLTC + otoLTC + circuLTC + respLTC + giLTC + mskLTC + guLTC + otherLTC) %>% 
  mutate(complexLTC = ifelse(complexLTC_count >=3, 1, 0))


##mixed physical + mental health conditions
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(physicalLTC =
          ifelse(diabetes==1|hypertens==1|painful==1|asthma==1|chd==1|dyspepsia==1|thyroid==1|rheumatoid==1|copd==1|stroketia==1|artfib==1|periphvasc==1|heartfail==1|glauc==1|epilepsy==1|ibd==1|bronch==1|parkin==1|ms==1|chronicliv==1|osteo==1|cfs==1|endomet==1|meniere==1|peranae==1|canceryes==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(mentalLTC = 
    ifelse(depression==1|alcoholprob==1|psychoactive==1|anxiety==1|dementia==1|schiz==1|anorexbul==1, 1, 0))

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(mixedLTC = ifelse(physicalLTC==1 & mentalLTC==1, 1, 0))


##pain clusters
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(painLTC = ifelse(painful==1, 1, 0))

##liver disease clusters
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  mutate(liverLTC = ifelse(chronicliv==1, 1, 0))


####MM group counts
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(mmcount_nockd_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(card_met_mmcount_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(complexLTC) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(mixedLTC) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(painLTC) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(liverLTC) %>%
  summarise(count = n())
```

```{r Frailty}
#FRAILTY PHENOTYPE - based on five criteria (low hand-grip strength, slow walking speed, weight loss, self-reported exhaustion, and low physical activity) and categorized as robust (0 criteria), pre-frail (1–2 criteria), and frail ( 3 criteria)

frailty_pheno <- readRDS("~/R working directory/UKB/Frailty/frailty_variables.rds")

#FRAILTY INDEX (FI) - list of deficits developed by Williams et al. for UK Biobank (excluding diabetes). The frailty index is calculated by dividing the number of deficits present by the total number of possible deficits, giving a value between 0 and 1 (higher values indicating a greater degree of frailty). Where an individual had missing data for a deficit, this deficit was also excluded from the denominator. FI>0.25 = frail

FI <- readRDS("~/R working directory/UKB/Frailty/frailty_index_deficits.rds")
FI = FI %>% 
  mutate(FI = total/total_non_missing)

#Merge files
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter <- merge(merge.ukbCKDRRTafter, FI, by="eid", all.x=TRUE)
merge.ukbCKDRRTafter <- merge(merge.ukbCKDRRTafter, frailty_pheno, by="eid", all.x=TRUE)

merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>%
  group_by(frailty_yesnopre) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

frail_check = merge.ukbCKDRRTafter %>% 
  filter(frailty_yesnopre == "Yes"|FI > 0.25)

frail_check %>% 
  summarise(count = n())

```

```{r comparing FI vs FI_lab}
  Range_Max = c(rangeFI[2], rangelabFI[2]))

grid.arrange(histoFI, histo_labFI, ncol=2)
```

```{r External validation of KFRE - lienar predictor and AUC}
##External validation of 4-var KFRE

#Calculate linear predictor for KFRE
# predictors<-c("age", "sexnumber", "acr2", "egfrcr09_race_allnonblack")

# original KFRE coefficients<-c(-0.2167, 0.2694, 0.45608, -0.55418)
# intercept_value <- 0.924

#non-North American KFRE - UK calibrated
coefficients<-c(-0.2201, 0.2467, 0.451, -0.5567)
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9832
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9878
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9365
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9570

linear_predictor = short_data %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))

PI_2 <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs

PI_5 <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(log_PI_2yrs = log(PI_2yrs))

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(centred_PI = sum((coefficients[1] + coefficients[2] + coefficients[3] + coefficients[4])*(mean(age)+mean(sexnumber)+mean(acr2))+mean(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)))

centred_PI <- linear_predictor$centred_PI

histogram_PI <- linear_predictor %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=log_PI_2yrs)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "darkred", fill = "red")+
  labs(x= "PI", y= "Frequency") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(linear_predictor$log_PI_2yrs, 0.16, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(linear_predictor$log_PI_2yrs, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = quantile(linear_predictor$log_PI_2yrs, 0.84, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "solid", color = "black")

##calculate survival time
linear_predictor$dateofdeath1[linear_predictor$dateofdeath1 == ""] <- NA
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
    mutate(admidate.y = ifelse(RRTafter == 0, NA, admidate.y),
         opdate = ifelse(RRTafter == 0, NA, opdate))




linear_predictor$end_fu <- as.Date("2020-04-26")


linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(dateofdeath1 = as.Date(dateofdeath1, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         admidate.y = as.Date(admidate.y, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         opdate = as.Date(opdate, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         end_fu = as.Date("2020-04-26")) %>% 
  mutate(death = ifelse(is.na(dateofdeath1), 0, 1)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    fudate = case_when(
      # If patient dies but no outcome → fudate = dateofdeath1
      !is.na(dateofdeath1) & is.na(admidate.y) & is.na(opdate) ~ dateofdeath1,
      
      # If outcome occurs before death → fudate = earliest of admidate.y or opdate
      (!is.na(admidate.y) | !is.na(opdate)) & (is.na(dateofdeath1) | pmin(admidate.y, opdate, na.rm = TRUE) < dateofdeath1) ~ pmin(admidate.y, opdate, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # If no death or outcome → fudate = end_fu
      TRUE ~ end_fu
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(futime_months = as.period(interval(asscentdate, fudate)) / months(1)) %>% 
  mutate(futime_days = as.period(interval(asscentdate, fudate)) / days(1)) %>% 
  mutate(futime_days_rounded = round(futime_days)) %>% 
  mutate(futime_months_rounded = round(futime_months)) %>% 
  mutate(death_afterRRT = ifelse(RRTafter==1 & death==1, 1, 0))

##Identify outcomes at 2 years and 5 years

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(outcome = ifelse(RRTafter==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(outcome_2yrs = 
  ifelse(outcome==1 & futime_months_rounded<=24, 1,
  ifelse(death==1 & futime_months_rounded<=24,0, 
  ifelse(outcome==1 & futime_months_rounded>24, 0,
  ifelse(outcome==0, 0,NA))))) %>% 
  mutate(outcome_5yrs =
  ifelse(outcome==1 & futime_months_rounded<=60, 1,
  ifelse(death==1 & futime_months_rounded<=60,0, 
  ifelse(outcome==1 & futime_months_rounded>60, 0,
  ifelse(outcome==0, 0,NA))))) %>% 
  mutate(death_2yrs = ifelse(death==1 &
futime_months_rounded<=24, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(death_5yrs = ifelse(death==1 & futime_months_rounded<=60, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(outcome_after5yrs = ifelse(outcome==1 & futime_months_rounded>60,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(death_after_5yrs = ifelse(death==1 & futime_months_rounded>60,1,0))

outcome_events_all <- table(linear_predictor$outcome,
                        useNA='always')
death_events_all <- table(linear_predictor$death,
                        useNA='always')
Outcome_events_2yrs <- table(linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs,
                        useNA='always')
Outcome_events_5yrs <- table(linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs,
                        useNA='always')
Death_events_2yrs <- table(linear_predictor$death_2yrs,

Death_events_5yrs <- table(linear_predictor$death_5yrs, useNA = "always")
Death_afterRRT_events <- table(linear_predictor$death_afterRRT,
                        useNA='always')
outcome_events_after5yrs<- table(linear_predictor$outcome_after5yrs,
                        useNA='always')
death_events_after5yrs<- table(linear_predictor$death_after5yrs,

combined_table <- cbind(
  outcome_events_all,

  death_events_after5yrs)

combined_table = (combined_table)

combined_table

##Explore when events are happening in time
# Convert months to years

# Convert event columns into a long format for easier plotting
data_long <- linear_predictor %>%

  filter(occurrence == 1)  # Keep only rows where event occurred

# Categorize follow-up time into 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5-year intervals
data_long <- data_long %>%
  mutate(follow_up_group = cut(futime_years, breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, Inf), 
                               labels = c("1 year", "2 years", "3 years", "4 years", "5 years", "5+ years"),
                               include.lowest = TRUE))

# Count events per follow-up year group
event_counts <- data_long %>%
  group_by(follow_up_group, event) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Plot bar chart of events within follow-up years
events_intime = ggplot(event_counts, aes(x = follow_up_group, y = count, fill = event)) +

  geom_text(aes(label = count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Number of Outcomes and Deaths Over Follow-up Years",

events_intime

#Fit original regression coefficients to UKB data and calculate linear predictor
coefficients <- c(age = -0.2201,
                 sexnumber = 0.2467,
                 acr2 = 0.451,
                 egfrcr09_race_allnonblack = -0.5567)
intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9570
intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9878

coef.orig <- list(coefficients = coefficients,
                  intercept = intercept_value_2yrs)


cox_model_2yrs = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs)

cox_model_5yrs = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs)

# Get the linear predictor from the Cox model
linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred <- as.numeric(predict(cox_model_2yrs, type = "lp"))

# Calculate predicted survival probabilities using the formula: S(t) = exp(-H0(t)^exp(cox_linear_pred))
linear_predictor$predicted_survival <- exp(-survfit(cox_model_2yrs)$surv * exp(linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred))

)

# Print the data frame with AUC and 95% CIs
```

```{r Discrimination measures}
##Harrel's c-index
#Original KFRE

C_index_2yrs <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]

##Linear predictor in different KFRE equations
#Cystatin
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_cys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012 )) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_cys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012))

PI_2_cys <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_cys

PI_5_cys <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_cys

#Combined CrCys
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_crcys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_crcys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))

PI_2_crcys <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_crcys

PI_5_crcys <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_crcys

##KFRE using eGFR cystatin equation
C_index_2yrs_cys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2_cys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs_cys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5_cys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]

##KFRE using eGFR combined creatinine cystatin equation
C_index_2yrs_crcys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2_crcys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs_crcys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5_crcys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]



# Create a data frame with c-index values
c_index_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Creatinine", "Creatinine", "Cystatin", "Cystatin", "Creatinine-Cystatin", "Creatinine-Cystatin"),
  Time = c("2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years"),
  C_Index = c(C_index_2yrs, C_index_5yrs, C_index_2yrs_cys, C_index_5yrs_cys, C_index_2yrs_crcys, C_index_5yrs_crcys)
)

# Reshape the data from long to wide format
c_index_table_wide <- c_index_table %>% 
  spread(key = Time, value = C_Index)

# Print the reshaped table
print(c_index_table_wide)


```

```{r c-index by FI-lab}
    Model = c("lab_FI_nonfrail_Creatinine", "lab_FI_nonfrail_Creatinine", "lab_FI_frail_Creatinine", "lab_FI_frail_Creatinine", "lab_FI_nonfrail_Cystatin", "lab_FI_nonfrail_Cystatin","lab_FI_frail_Cystatin", "lab_FI_frail_Cystatin", "lab_FI_nonfrail_Creatinine-Cystatin", "lab_FI_nonfrail_Creatinine-Cystatin", "lab_FI_frail_Creatinine-Cystatin", "lab_FI_frail_Creatinine-Cystatin"),
    Time = c("2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years"),
    lab_FI_C_Index = c(lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_2yrs, lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_5yrs, lab_FI_frail_C_index_2yrs, lab_FI_frail_C_index_5yrs, lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_2yrs_cys, lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_5yrs_cys, lab_FI_frail_C_index_2yrs_cys, lab_FI_frail_C_index_5yrs_cys, lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_2yrs_crcys, lab_FI_nonfrail_C_index_5yrs_crcys, lab_FI_frail_C_index_2yrs_crcys, lab_FI_frail_C_index_5yrs_crcys)
  )
  
  # Reshape the data from long to wide format
  lab_FI_c_index_table_wide <- lab_FI_c_index_table %>% 
    spread(key = Time, value = lab_FI_C_Index)
  
  # Print the reshaped table
  print(lab_FI_c_index_table_wide)
```

```{r KM curves for risk groups}



##Original KFRE

cutoffs <- c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.50, Inf)

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(risk_group_KFRE = cut(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1, breaks = cutoffs, 
                                  include.lowest = TRUE,
                                  labels = c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%")))

fit_KFRE <- survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome) ~ risk_group_KFRE, data = linear_predictor)

# Create survival curve plot
KFRE_orig <- ggsurvplot(fit_KFRE)
```

```{r Calibration plots KFRE creatinine}

###KFRE Cr 2yrs
#Split into deciles 
linear_predictor$riskCr <- as.factor(ntile(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1,10))

# Predicted risks

pred.KFRECr <- linear_predictor %>% 
  group_by(riskCr) %>% 
  summarise(meanCr = mean(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1, na.rm = FALSE))


# KM observed risks and confidence interval
cal.KFRECr_2yr <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ riskCr, data = linear_predictor, conf.type="log-log"),
                  extend = TRUE, times = 24)
Cr_2yr_risk1 <- 1 - cal.KFRECr_2yr$surv
Cr_2yr_risk.u <- 1 - cal.KFRECr_2yr$lower
Cr_2yr_risk.l <- 1 - cal.KFRECr_2yr$upper

# plot predicted versus observed risk 
calib.KFRECr_2yr <- data.frame(pred.KFRECr$meanCr, Cr_2yr_risk1, Cr_2yr_risk.l, Cr_2yr_risk.u)
KFRECr_2yr1 <- ggplot(calib.KFRECr_2yr, aes(pred.KFRECr.meanCr, Cr_2yr_risk1)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Cr_2yr_risk.l, ymax = Cr_2yr_risk.u, width = 0.02), colour="blue") +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour="coral1", linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "KFRE within 2 years using eGFR CKDEPI 2009 creatinine equation", y = "Observed risk", x = "Predicted risk") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy=1), limits=c(0, 1.0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy=1), limits=c(0, 1.0)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold"))

# The distribution plot

  xlab("Predicted risk") +
  ylab("") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold"))
```

```{r Baseline characteristics tables}

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(mm = ifelse(mmcount_nockd <=1, 0, 1)) %>% 
  mutate(frail = ifelse(FI > 0.25 | frailty_yesnopre %in% c("Yes") | lab_FI > 0.25, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(FI_frail1 = ifelse(FI > 0.25, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(pheno_frail1 = ifelse(frailty_yesnopre %in% c("Yes"), 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(lab_FI_frail1 = ifelse(lab_FI > 0.25, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(cardio_mm = ifelse(card_met_mmcount_cat==0|card_met_mmcount_cat==1, 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(complexLTC1 = ifelse(complexLTC==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(painLTC1 = ifelse(painLTC==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(mixedLTC1 = ifelse(mixedLTC==1, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(crcys_discrep = eGFRcys_2012 - egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)

linear_predictor$card_met_mmcount_cat==2|linear_predictor$card_met_mmcount_cat=="3 or more"

# Define the summary statistics for each variable
summaries <- list(
  Age = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(age),
    "Max" = ~ max(age),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(age)
  ),
  eGFR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Max" = ~ max(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)
  ),
  eGFRCys = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Max" = ~ max(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(eGFRcys_2012)
  ),
   eGFRCyseGFRCrdiscrepency = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(crcys_discrep),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(crcys_discrep),
    "Max" = ~ max(crcys_discrep),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(crcys_discrep)
  ),
  "Cystatin C" = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(cystatin),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(cystatin),
    "Max" = ~ max(cystatin),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(cystatin)
  ),
  ACR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(acr2),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(acr2),
    "Max" = ~ max(acr2),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(acr2)
  ),
  Sex = list(
    "Male" = ~ n_perc0(sexnumber == 1),
    "Female" = ~ n_perc0(sexnumber == 0)
  ),
  "Follow-up time (months)" = list(
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(futime_months),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(futime_months)
  ),
  Death = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(death == 1)
  ),
  "ESKD within 2 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0((outcome_2yrs ==0))
  ),
  "ESKD within 5 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_5yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0((outcome_2yrs ==0))
  ),
  "LTC count" = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(mmcount_nockd[!is.na(mmcount_nockd)]
  )),
  "Frailty" = list(
    "Median FI score (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(FI),
    "Median lab-FI score (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(lab_FI[!is.na(lab_FI)]),
    "Frailty phenotype - Frail" = ~ n_perc0(frailty_yesnopre=="Yes")
  )
)
```

```{r  O/E ratios egfrcr}
## O/E ratio

#whole cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5 <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = linear_predictor), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5 <- (1 - obj5$surv)/mean(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2 <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = linear_predictor), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2 <- (1 - obj2$surv)/mean(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)

#mm cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5_mm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = mm), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5_mm <- (1 - obj5_mm$surv)/mean(mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2_mm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = mm), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2_mm <- (1 - obj2_mm$surv)/mean(mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)

#no_mm cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5_nomm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = no_mm), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5_nomm <- (1 - obj5_nomm$surv)/mean(no_mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2_nomm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = no_mm), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2_nomm <- (1 - obj2_nomm$surv)/mean(no_mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)


# Confidence intervals using method proposed in Debray et al. (2017)
alpha <- 0.05
OE_summary_cr <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("OE", "Lower .95", "Upper .95"),
  whole_cohort_5 = c(OE_5, exp(log(OE_5 - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5$std.err / (1-obj5$surv))), exp(log(OE_5 + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5$std.err / (1-obj5$surv)))),
  whole_cohort_2 = c(OE_2, exp(log(OE_2 - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2$std.err / (1-obj2$surv))),exp(log(OE_2 + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2$std.err / (1-obj2$surv)))),
  mm_5 = c(OE_5_mm, exp(log(OE_5_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv)))),
  mm_2 = c(OE_2_mm, exp(log(OE_2_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv)))),
  nomm_5 = c(OE_5_nomm, exp(log(OE_5_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv)))),
  nomm_2 = c(OE_2_nomm, exp(log(OE_2_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))))
  )


kable(OE_summary_cr) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r  O/E ratios egfrcys}
  mm_5 = c(OE_5_mm, exp(log(OE_5_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv)))),
  mm_2 = c(OE_2_mm, exp(log(OE_2_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv)))),
  nomm_5 = c(OE_5_nomm, exp(log(OE_5_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv)))),
  nomm_2 = c(OE_2_nomm, exp(log(OE_2_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))))
  )

  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r calibration intercept & slope impute acr 0.1 for 0 & recalculate PI}
####IMPUTE uACR 0.1 when 0 values are present

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(acr3 = (if_else(acr2==0, 0.1, acr2))) %>% 
mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3 = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace(age, sexnumber, acr3, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_acr3 = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012(age, sexnumber, acr3, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3 = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack(age, sexnumber, acr3, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)) %>% 
  mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_2yr(age, sexnumber, acr3, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_acr3_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_2yr(age, sexnumber, acr3, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_2yr(age, sexnumber, acr3, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))

###################################################################

#non-North American KFRE 
coefficients<-c(-0.2201, 0.2467, 0.451, -0.5567)
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9832
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9878
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9365
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9570

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_acr3 = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr3) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_acr3 = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr3) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))

PI_2_acr3 <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_acr3

PI_5_acr3 <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_acr3

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(log_PI_2yrs_acr3 = log(PI_2yrs_acr3))
###################################################################

cox_model_2yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)

cox_model_5yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs_acr3)

# Get the linear predictor from the Cox model
linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred_acr3 <- as.numeric(predict(cox_model_2yrs_acr3, type = "lp"))

# Calculate predicted survival probabilities using the formula: S(t) = exp(-H0(t)^exp(cox_linear_pred))
linear_predictor$predicted_survival_acr3 <- exp(-survfit(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)$surv * exp(linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred_acr3))



cox_model_2yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)

cox_model_5yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs_acr3)
```

```{r calibration intercept and slope - creatinine 2 years}
####whole cohort - creatinine
# log cumulative hazard
linear_predictor$cumhaz_acr3 <- log(-log(1-linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr))
# Pseudo-observations
km.whole_2 <- survfit(Surv(fu_2, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=linear_predictor)
linear_predictor$yhat2 <- 1 - pseudo(km.whole_2, times=24, type="surv")
summary(linear_predictor$yhat2)

pseudos <- data.frame(linear_predictor$Calibration$plotframe)

# model for calibration intercept
whole_cal_int_2 <- geese(
  yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3), 
  data = linear_predictor, 
  id = eid, 
  scale.fix = TRUE, 
  family = gaussian, 
  mean.link = "cloglog",
  corstr = "independence", 
  jack = TRUE)

# model for calibration slope
whole_cal_slope_2 <- geese(yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3) + cumhaz_acr3, data = linear_predictor, id=eid, scale.fix = TRUE, 
                      family = gaussian, mean.link = "cloglog",
                      corstr = "independence", jack = TRUE)

res_cal_2 <- rbind(
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration intercept
  "Intercept" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_int_2)$mean,
    c(
      "estimate" = estimate,
      `2.5 %` = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se,
      `97.5 %` = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se
    )
  ),
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration slope
  "Slope" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_slope_2)$mean["cumhaz_acr3", ],
    c(
      "estimate" = 1 + estimate,
      `2.5 %` = 1 + (estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se),
      `97.5 %` = 1 + (estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se)
    )
  )
)

kable(res_cal_2) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r measures by KFRE risk groups}
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)
  ),
  eGFRCys = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(eGFRcys_2012)
  ),
  ACR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(acr2),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(acr2),
    "Max" = ~ max(acr2),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(acr2)
  ),
  Sex = list(

   LTCcount = list(

    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(mmcount_nockd[!is.na(mmcount_nockd)])),
  LTCnperc = list(
    "MM" = ~ n_perc0((mm == 1))
  ),
   Death = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(death == 1)
  ),
  Death_2yrs =list(
    "Yes"= ~ n_perc0(death_2yrs == 1)
  ),
    Death_5yrs =list(
    "Yes"= ~ n_perc0(death_5yrs == 1)
  ),
  "ESKD within 2 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==0)
  ),
  "ESKD within 5 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_5yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==0)
  )
)
```

```{r precision, recall, PPV, AUPROC - whole cohort 2 years}
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% mutate(KFRE_GT5_2yr = ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr>= 0.05, 1, 0),
                                                  outcome_2yrs = factor(outcome_2yrs, levels = c(0, 1)),

# Predicted and actual labels
predicted <- linear_predictor$KFRE_GT5_2yr
actual <- linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs

KFRE_2yrs_GT5_metrics <- confusionMatrix(predicted, actual,
                mode = "everything",
                positive="1")

KFRE_2yrs_GT5_metrics


pred_probs <- linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr
labels <- linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs

auprc_boot <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = d$pred[d$label == 1],
                 scores.class1 = d$pred[d$label == 0],
                 curve = FALSE)
  return(pr$auc.integral)
}

# Scores for positive and negative classes
pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = pred_probs[labels == 1],
               scores.class1 = pred_probs[labels == 0],
               curve = TRUE)

# Show AUPRC
print(pr$auc.integral)

df <- data.frame(pred = pred_probs, label = labels)

# Run bootstrap (e.g., 1000 replicates)
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = auprc_boot, R = 1000)

# 95% CI
boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
```

```{r overall fit - Brier and scaled Brier scores creatinine 2 years}
# Overall fit - whole cohort
# Brier Score
brier.whole <- Score(list(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=linear_predictor, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                  conf.int=TRUE, times=24, summary="ipa")
brier.whole
str(brier.whole)


brier.mm <- Score(list(mm_acr3$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=mm_acr3, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                 conf.int=TRUE, times=24, summary="ipa")

brier.nomm <- Score(list(no_mm_acr3$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=no_mm_acr3, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                 conf.int=TRUE, times=24, summary="ipa")


# Table overall measures - creatinine
res_ov_whole <-data.frame(
  Measure = c("whole cohort", "mm", "nomm"),
 Brier = c(brier.whole$Brier$score$Brier[brier.whole$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm$Brier$score$Brier[brier.mm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm$Brier$score$Brier[brier.nomm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]),
Lower.95 = c(brier.whole$Brier$score$lower[brier.whole$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm$Brier$score$lower[brier.mm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm$Brier$score$lower[brier.nomm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]), 
Upper.95 = c(brier.whole$Brier$score$upper[brier.whole$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm$Brier$score$upper[brier.mm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm$Brier$score$upper[brier.nomm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"] ),
scaledbrier = c(brier.whole$Brier$score$IPA[brier.whole$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm$Brier$score$IPA[brier.mm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm$Brier$score$IPA[brier.nomm$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]))


kable(res_ov_whole) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")




# Scaled Brier Score - bootstrap for 95% CI
B_boot <- function(data, i) {
  val <- data[i,]
  brier <- Score(list(val$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=val, metrics="Brier",
                 cens.model="km", conf.int=TRUE, times=24, summary="ipa")
  scaled <- brier$Brier$score$IPA
}

bboot.whole <- boot(linear_predictor, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.whole, index=2, type="perc")

bboot.mm <- boot(mm_acr3, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.mm, index=2, type="perc")

bboot.nomm <- boot(no_mm_acr3, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.nomm, index=2, type="perc")
```

```{r overall fit - Brier and scaled Brier scores creatinine-cystatin 5 years}
brier.whole5 <- Score(list(linear_predictor$KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data=linear_predictor, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                  conf.int=TRUE, times=60, summary="ipa")
brier.whole
str(brier.whole)


brier.mm5 <- Score(list(mm_acr3$KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data=mm_acr3, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                 conf.int=TRUE, times=60, summary="ipa")

brier.nomm5 <- Score(list(no_mm_acr3$KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data=no_mm_acr3, metrics=c("auc", "Brier"),
                 conf.int=TRUE, times=60, summary="ipa")


# Table overall measures - creatinine cystatin
res_ov_whole_crcys5 <-data.frame(
  Measure = c("whole cohort", "mm", "nomm"),
 Brier = c(brier.whole5$Brier$score$Brier[brier.whole5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm5$Brier$score$Brier[brier.mm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm5$Brier$score$Brier[brier.nomm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]),
Lower.95 = c(brier.whole5$Brier$score$lower[brier.whole5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm5$Brier$score$lower[brier.mm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm5$Brier$score$lower[brier.nomm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]), 
Upper.95 = c(brier.whole5$Brier$score$upper[brier.whole5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm5$Brier$score$upper[brier.mm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm5$Brier$score$upper[brier.nomm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"] ),
scaledbrier = c(brier.whole5$Brier$score$IPA[brier.whole5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.mm5$Brier$score$IPA[brier.mm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"], brier.nomm5$Brier$score$IPA[brier.nomm5$Brier$score$model == "numeric"]))


kable(res_ov_whole_crcys5) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")




# Scaled Brier Score - bootstrap for 95% CI
B_boot <- function(data, i) {
  val <- data[i,]
  brier <- Score(list(val$KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3), formula = Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data=val, metrics="Brier",
                 cens.model="km", conf.int=TRUE, times=60, summary="ipa")
  scaled <- brier$Brier$score$IPA
}

bboot.whole.crcys <- boot(linear_predictor, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.whole.crcys, index=2, type="perc")

bboot.mm.crcys <- boot(mm_acr3, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.mm.crcys, index=2, type="perc")

bboot.nomm.crcys <- boot(no_mm_acr3, B_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=bboot.nomm.crcys, index=2, type="perc")
```

```{r}
#Fit original regression coefficients to UKB data and calculate linear predictor
coefficients <- c(age = -0.2201,
                 sexnumber = 0.2467,
                 acr2 = 0.451,
                 egfrcr09_race_allnonblack = -0.5567)
intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9570
intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9878

coef.orig <- list(coefficients = coefficients,
                  intercept = intercept_value_2yrs)


cox_model_2yrs = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs)

cox_model_5yrs = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs)

creat_model_5 <- coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs, data = linear_predictor)

cys_model_5 <- coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5_cys, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cys_model_5)

crcys_model_5 <- coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5_crcys, data = linear_predictor)

summary(crcys_model_5)

anova(cys_model_5, creat_model_5, test = "LRT")

anova(crcys_model_5, creat_model_5, test = "LRT")

anova(crcys_model_5, cys_model_5, test = "LRT")

anova(creat_model_5, cys_model_5, test = "LRT")
```

#c-index 95% CIs

```{r c-index 95% CI FI_frail }

FI_frail <- FI_frail %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_cys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012 )) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_cys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012))

FI_frail <- FI_frail %>% 
 mutate(PI_2yrs_crcys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_crcys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * sexnumber) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))

FI_frail = FI_frail %>%
mutate(time = (futime_months/12))
two.trunc.FI_frail <- FI_frail
two.trunc.FI_frail$outcome <- ifelse(two.trunc.FI_frail$time>2, 0, two.trunc.FI_frail$outcome) 
two.trunc.FI_frail$time <- ifelse(two.trunc.FI_frail$time>2, 2.001, two.trunc.FI_frail$time)

# c index – Cr 2yrs
rcorr.cens(-1*two.trunc.FI_frail$PI_2yrs, Surv(two.trunc.FI_frail$time, two.trunc.FI_frail$outcome))[1]

#print(length(two.trunc.FI_frail$PI_2yrs))
#print(length(two.trunc.FI_frail$time))
#print(length(two.trunc.FI_frail$outcome))


# Bootstrap c-index to get confidence interval – Cr 2yrs
set.seed(1234)
C_boot <- function(data, i) {
  val <- data[i,] # select sample with boot
  rcorr.cens(-1*val$PI_2yrs, Surv(val$time, val$outcome))[1]
}
set.seed(1234)
twoboot.FI_frail <- boot(two.trunc.FI_frail, C_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=twoboot.FI_frail, type="norm")


############################################################

five.trunc.FI_frail <- FI_frail
five.trunc.FI_frail$outcome <- ifelse(five.trunc.FI_frail$time>5, 0, five.trunc.FI_frail$outcome) 
five.trunc.FI_frail$time <- ifelse(five.trunc.FI_frail$time>5, 5.001, five.trunc.FI_frail$time)

# c index – Cr 5yrs
rcorr.cens(-1*five.trunc.FI_frail$PI_5yrs, Surv(five.trunc.FI_frail$time, five.trunc.FI_frail$outcome))[1]
```

```{r c-index 95% CI nonfrail all measures }
rcorr.cens(-1*five.trunc.non_frail_allmeasures$PI_5yrs_crcys, Surv(five.trunc.non_frail_allmeasures$time, five.trunc.non_frail_allmeasures$outcome))[1]


# Bootstrap c-index to get confidence interval:
set.seed(1234)
C_boot <- function(data, i) {
  val <- data[i,] # select sample with boot
  rcorr.cens(-1*val$PI_5yrs_crcys, Surv(val$time, val$outcome))[1]
}
set.seed(1234)
fiveboot.non_frail_allmeasures <- boot(five.trunc.non_frail_allmeasures, C_boot, R=1000)
boot.ci(boot.out=fiveboot.non_frail_allmeasures, type="norm")

```

##Competing risk of mortality 

```{r}
# Import dataset for competing risks analysis
compr <- readRDS("~/R working directory/UKB/new_ukb.rds")

# Change event indicator to three variables - ESKD=1, Death=2
compr$event <- ifelse(compr$death==1, 2, 0)
compr$event <- ifelse(compr$outcome==1, 1, compr$event)
compr = compr %>% 
  mutate(time = (futime_months/12))

# Risk group of pre-proposed risks
# Risk group of pre-proposed risks
compr$riskgrp <- cut(compr$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1, breaks=c(0, 0.03, 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.5, 1), 
                     labels=c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%"),
                     right = FALSE)

compr_FI_frail <- subset(compr, compr$FI > 0.25,)
compr_FI_nonfrail <- subset(compr, compr$FI <= 0.25,)
compr_pheno_frail <- subset(compr, compr$frailty_yesnopre == "Yes",)
compr_pheno_prefrail <- subset(compr, compr$frailty_yesnopre == "Pre-frail",)
compr_pheno_nonfrail <- subset(compr, compr$frailty_yesnopre == "No",)


compr_labFI_frail <- subset(compr, compr$lab_FI > 0.25,)
compr_labFI_nonfrail <- subset(compr, compr$lab_FI <= 0.25,)

compr_frail_any <- subset(compr, compr$FI > 0.25| compr$lab_FI >0.25|compr$frailty_yesnopre =="Yes",)
compr_nonfrail_any <- subset(compr, compr$FI <= 0.25|compr$lab_FI <= 0.25|compr$frailty_yesnopre == "No",)
```

```{r Cumulative incidence curves}

# AJ for mm & nomm no risk group
aj_frail_any <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ 1, data = compr_frail_any)
aj_nonfrail_any <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ 1, data = compr_nonfrail_any)

# Plot risk of both causes
pdf(file="compr_UKB_frailty_allmeasures.pdf", width=15, height=6)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))

CR_frail_any_5 <- plot(aj_frail_any, cause="stacked", confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
     ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure or death", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0, 5), 
     legend.title="Competing risk",
     legend.legend=c("Kidney failure", "Death"), 
     legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.9, lwd=2)
title("Cumulative Incidence curve:\nFrailty cohort")


CR_nonfrail_any_5 <- plot(aj_nonfrail_any, cause="stacked", confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,

title("Cumulative Incidence curve:\nNo frailty cohort")



# AJ for with risk groups - find cifs for KRT and death for each group
aj_risk <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~riskgrp, data = compr)
summary(aj_risk, times = 5, extend = T)

# Count of ESKD events

# Count of Death events
death_count <- sum(compr$event == 2)

event_counts_by_riskgrp <- table(compr$riskgrp, compr$event)
```

```{r Kaplan Meier vs Aalen-Johansen estimates by risk group}


## AJ estimator: frail vs nonfrail
aj1 <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ riskgrp, data = compr_frail_any)
aj2 <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ riskgrp, data = compr_nonfrail_any)
# KM estimator: mm vs nomm
km1 <- prodlim(Hist(time, event==1) ~ riskgrp, data=compr_frail_any)
km2 <- prodlim(Hist(time, event==1) ~ riskgrp, data=compr_nonfrail_any)

pdf(file="KM AJ by risk group_UKB_frail_anymeasure.pdf", width=15, height=6)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))



# Frailty any measures
n_colors <- 5

# Generate the magma color palette
colors <- viridis(n_colors, option = "viridis")

plot(aj1, cause=1, confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
      ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0,5),
      legend.title="Risk group (%)",
      legend.legend=c("<3", "3-<5", "5-<15", "15-<25", "25-<50", "\u226550"), 
      legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.85, lwd=2.5, col=colors)
plot(km1, type="risk", add=TRUE, confint=FALSE, xlim = c(0,5), lty="dashed", lwd=2.5, col=colors)
title("Kaplan-Meier & Cumulative Incidence curves:\nFrailty cohort")


# No frailty all measures
plot(aj2, cause=1, confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
      ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0,5),
      legend.title="Risk group (%)",
      legend.legend=c("<3", "3-<5", "5-<15", "15-<25", "25-<50", "\u226550"), 
      legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.85, lwd=2.5, col=colors)
plot(km2, type="risk", add=TRUE, confint=FALSE, xlim = c(0,5), lty="dashed", lwd=2.5, col=colors)
title("Kaplan-Meier & Cumulative Incidence curves:\nNo frailty cohort")
```
